structured_stats.description:
The '''Soldier''' is a starter ground tower that fires in bursts. It can be bought for {{Coins|350}} in the store.

The '''Soldier''' fires in bursts, with a short delay between each burst. It is a fairly cheap tower, making it recommended for use in earlier waves. It gains hidden detection at Level 2 and flying detection at Level 4 (Level 0 for [[PVP]]), so it is an effective counter against [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Flying]] enemies.

The '''Soldier''' is considered an early to mid-game tower. Later on during the game, its effectiveness dwindles against high health enemies, being outclassed by other towers with higher DPS.

The '''Soldier''' would walk down the path from the exit to the entrance. If any enemies entered its range, it start firing at enemies. Similarly to the [[Soldier]] tower, it fired in bursts. Once there were no more enemies in range, it would wait a while before starting to walk again. ==Appearance== The '''Soldier''' was very similar to the [[Soldier]] tower, specifically Level 2 of the default skin. It had tan skin, a green shirt, blue pants, black shoes, dark green cap, black shades and a black headset. It wielded an M16A2 that it attacked enemies with. ==Trivia== *The '''Soldier''' is based on the [[Soldier]] tower, though there are a few differences between them. **While the units appearance is based on the Level 2 default [[Soldier]] from the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the weapon it carries lacks a laser. It also has tan skin, while the tower has pale skin. **Barring statistics needed for a unit but not the tower, like health, the unit also has 25 range while the tower at the time of its release had a range of 13. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Soldier''' added. *'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]] **'''Soldier''' firerate decreased from 0.23 to 0.225 due to [[Firerate Bug]] getting less severe for units. *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Soldier''' firerate increased from 0.225 to 0.23 due to [[Firerate Bug]] getting more severe for units. *'''9 January 2023''' - [[v1.6.0]]f **'''Soldier''' firerate decreased from 0.23 to 0.225 due to [[Firerate Bug]] getting less severe for units. *'''10 February 2024''' - [[v1.13.0]] **'''Soldier''' removed. {{TowerNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Soldier}}

==Description==
The '''Damage Buff''' is a buff that increases a tower's damage, making them stronger. It is displayed on the tower itself with the icon of an arm with muscle.

==Mechanics==
'''Damage Buff''' range reduction is calculated as:
::<big>'''Damage × (1 + Damage Buff)'''</big>
:::where '''Damage Buff''' is the debuff supplied in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

The damage increased by the '''Damage Buff''' will always round down to the nearest integer. For example, a tower that deals 5 damage with a 50% '''Damage Buff''' will deal 7 damage, instead of 7.5.

Multiple towers are not fully affected by the buff. A full list of towers affected fully, partially or that are unaffected can be found below.
{{DamageBuff}}

==Applied By==
The following towers or consumables can apply the '''Damage Buff''' to other towers or itself:
*[[DJ Booth]] (Passive)
*[[Mercenary Base]] (Passive)
*[[Damage Flag]] (Passive)
*[[War Machine]] (Passive)
*[[Medic]] (''Ubercharge'' ability)
*[[Warden]] (When parrying)

The following event features can apply the '''Damage Buff''' to towers:

* [[Justice]] (Passive, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])

==Description==
The '''Firerate Buff''' is a buff that decreases a tower's firerate, making them fire faster. It is displayed on the towers using an icon of a lightning bolt.

==Mechanics==
Currently, the '''Firerate Buff''' is calculated as:
::<big>'''Original Firerate ÷ (1 + Firerate Buff)'''</big>
:::where '''Firerate Buff''' is the buff supplied is in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

While it may look like the firerate of a tower with the '''Firerate Buff''' is rounded up or down to the third decimal, this is only visual. 

Prior to the [[v2.0.0]] update, the firerate of a tower with the [[Firerate Bug]] was calculated as:
::<big>'''(Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) ÷ (1 + Firerate Buff) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>
:::where ''Bugged Firerate'' was the firerate with the [[Firerate Bug]].

Prior to the [[V1.1.0|Entity System Update]], the '''Firerate Buff''' was calculated as:

::Without the [[Firerate Bug]]:
:::<big>'''Original Firerate × (1-Firerate Buff)'''</big>
::With the [[Firerate Bug]]:
:::<big>'''((Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) × (1 - Firerate Buff)) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>

The following towers are either partially or fully not affected by the '''Firerate Buff''':
*All [[units]].
*Ability cooldowns.
*Units spawnrates.
*The [[Commander]]; the [[Commander]] cannot boost the firerate of other [[Commander]]s.
*Firerate of secondary attacks, like the [[Pursuit]]'s missiles.
**Their main firerate can still be decreased.
*Tick of the [[Pyromancer]], [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Cryomancer]], [[Slasher]] and [[Swarmer]].
**The tick of the [[Accelerator]] can still be decreased.
*The rev-up of the [[Minigunner]].
*Charge-up and cooldown of the [[Accelerator]].
**The cooldown of burst towers like the [[Soldier]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] also cannot be decreased.
*The [[Executioner]]; the firerate will not be decreased if the axe takes too long to return.
*The [[Archer]]; the '''Firerate Buff''' can decrease the time it takes for it to reload its bow, but it cannot decrease the time it takes it to aim at enemies.

The pump time for the [[Enforcer]] is also affected by this buff.

==Applied By==

related_pages.wikitext_excerpt:
{{Removed|date = 6th of June 2026}}
{{Improve|this page and majority of tower/unit pages require updating}}
The '''Firerate Bug''', also known as the '''RoF (Rate of Fire) Bug''', was a bug that slightly increased the firerate of all towers and units. This increase was not displayed on the statistics in the game. This bug significantly affected the statistics of fast-firing towers, such as the [[Minigunner]] and [[Ace Pilot]], by significantly decreasing their DPS, whereas slow-firing towers like the [[Ranger]] or [[Sniper]] were hardly affected.

This has been fixed as of the 6th of June 2026, and all firerate statistics in the game are considered to be accurate unless affected by a different unrelated bug.

{{RightTOC}}

==Prior to 5th of June 2026==
The '''Firerate Bug''' affects all towers and units that can directly attack enemies, meaning the only towers that are not affected are the [[Farm]], [[Medic]] and the [[Firework Technician]] and the only units that are not affected are the [[Humvee]], [[Humvee 2]], [[Elf]], [[Bomber Elf (Unit)|Bomber Elf]], [[Skeleton (Unit)|Skeleton]], [[Giant Skeleton (Unit)|Giant Skeleton]] and [[Hallow Guard (Unit)|Hallow Guard]]. The '''Firerate Bug''' does not affect the firerate of some secondary attacks towers or units may perform, some damage-over-time effects applied by towers (like burn from the [[Pyromancer]]) or certain other cooldowns.

The '''Firerate Bug''' increases the firerate of a tower/unit depending on its firerate, which can vary anywhere between 0.017 and 0.032 seconds. The firerate increase affects fast firing towers the most; for example, the [[Minigunner]] at Level 4 should have a firerate of 0.09, but because of the '''Firerate Bug''', it has a firerate of about 0.117, decreasing its DPS from 166.67 to 128.20, which is a decrease of 38.47 DPS, or a loss of about 23.08 DPS. Meanwhile, slow firing towers are barely affected by it; for example, the [[Ranger]] at Level 4 should have a firerate of 8, but because of the '''Firerate Bug''', it has a firerate of about 8.025, decreasing its DPS from 156.26 to 155.76, which is a decrease of 0.30 DPS, or a loss of 0.2% DPS.

The [[Firerate Buff]] is also affected by the '''Firerate Bug''', making it less effective. For example, the Level 4 [[Minigunner]] without the '''Firerate Bug''' with a 50% firerate boost should have a firerate of 0.06, but with the '''Firerate Bug''' it has a firerate of 0.083. This means that its DPS with a 50% firerate boost is decreased from 250 to 180.72, which is a decrease of 69.28 DPS, or a loss of 27.71% DPS.

On this Wiki, the firerate statistic of all towers and units is increased by specific values based on the firerate. While technically possible to calculate by hand, due to the effort it would take, it is overall recommended to either use [[Help:Neowtext#ROFBUG|Neowtext]] or [https://fiheron.github.io/dps-calc/ an online calculator].

==Prior to the 9th of January 2023==
Prior to the 9th of January 2023, the firerate increase caused by the '''Firerate Bug''' for units was higher than it currently is. The firerate increase was generally around 0.03 seconds. For towers, the firerate increase remained at around 0.008 seconds.

On this Wiki, the firerate statistic of all towers and units after the [[V1.6.0|Violent Night Update]] and before the 9th of January 2023 is increased by 0.008 and 0.03 respectively, unless stated otherwise. This does not, however, mean the actual value is this; it can vary between towers and even between matches.

==Prior to the Violent Night Update==
Prior to the [[V1.6.0|Violent Night Update]], the firerate increase caused by the '''Firerate Bug''' for units was lower than it was before the [[V1.6.0|Violent Night Update]]. The firerate increases could be anywhere between 0.008 and 0.017 seconds, but the increase was generally around 0.008 seconds. This is the same as the current situation.

Towers need flying detection to target these enemies. ==Mechanics== '''Flying''' enemies fly above the path, which grants them multiple perks. The main immunity that it grants is requiring flying detection to target them, making it difficult for towers without said detection to damage a '''Flying''' enemy. '''Flying''' enemies have various other unique immunities that are applied, outside of flying detection: # They are completely immune to being damaged by unit collision damage, even if they would normally collide with each other. #*This includes the [[Gift Bomber]], which cannot collide with '''Flying''' enemies, despite visually passing through '''Flying''' enemies. #*Some units, like the [[Rifleman]] or [[Missile APC]], can detect flying enemies, even if they cannot collide with them. #They are able to fly over road hazards, namely the [[Trapper]]'s traps and the [[Harvester]]'s thorns (and by extension the [[Farm]]'s). #*The [[Commando]]'s missiles, can still affect them. #*The [[Barricade]] can collide with '''Flying''' enemies, but they deal unit collision damage. This does not mean they are immune to other effects from attacks that knock back enemies. #*For example, the [[DJ Booth]] can still slow down '''Flying''' enemies, even if the purple track cannot knock them back. '''Flying''' enemies may be indirectly damaged by towers, even if they do not have flying detection. For example, the [[Brawler]]'s ''Reposition'' ability deals damage to '''Flying''' enemies, though due to their knockback immunity it does not knock them back. Build up chill to slow and freeze enemies in their tracks!|Store Description}} |-|Version 3 = {{QuoteBox|Chill enemies to a slow freeze!|Store Description}} |-|Version 2 = {{QuoteBox|Shoot an ice beam, freezing targets for a few seconds.|Store Description}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Freeze zombies temporarily with a freeze ray!|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Freezer''' is a ground [[Towers|tower]] that fires an ice beam and applies chill and slow down enemies, freezing at later levels. It can be bought in the store for {{Coins|650}}. The '''Freezer''' targets a single enemy and fires a ''Frost Ray'', chilling the enemy and slowing it down. The chillness slowness effect stacks with each hit multiple times. This chillness effect also deals damage over time, chipping away the health of enemies affected by it. Starting from Level 2, it can freeze enemies. When the chillness slowness effect is higher than the max slowdown, the enemy will be frozen, which generally when targeting a single enemy takes four or five shots. Larger enemies will be frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. Enemies with [[Freeze Immunity]] also cannot be frozen, slowed down or have their defense dropped by the '''Freezer'''. At Level 3+, the '''Freezer''' fires in bursts, with a short delay between them. Additionally, at Level 3+, it drops defense by 10% every tick. It can only decrease an enemy's defense by 33%. For example, if an enemy has 50% defense, it will be decreased by 16%. On top of this, it will also start dealing damage over time with its chill at Level 3. Additionally at Level 4, the '''Freezer''' gains the ability to throw a '''Frost Grenade''', freezing enemies within an explosion radius. The '''Freezer''' does well as an all-rounder support tower. Due to its generally low price and decent DPS, the '''Freezer''' can be a solid choice for early-game defense to mid game with very good cost efficiency. Towards late game, the '''Freezer''' is useful for stalling, defense melting and deal additional DPS through its damage over time, though its DPS is insufficient to deal with late-game waves alone. The '''Freezer''' has [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] detection from Level 0 and [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] detection from level 2.
